statement: Deterministic deliverable for the double-ceremony drill: mandated work delivery (market.deliver_result.v1, provider mandate) followed by mandated buyer acceptance with escrow release (market.approve_delivery.v1, buyer mandate). The sha3-256 of this exact file is pre-committed in the signed one-shot provider mandate before delivery, committed on-chain via deliver_result_v2, and re-verified by the buyer mandate policy (G3) before approve_delivery_v2 releases the escrow.
